description: The recommended option of a question gate (openspec polish-prototype-style, design decision 3): the index of the first option whose label contains "(Recommended)" in any case, else 0; -1 for no options. The card shows that option as the filled button. Source: the AskUserQuestion tool description of Claude Code 2.1.331 ("add (Recommended) at the end of the label"), read on 2026-11-24. The labels are synthetic. TypeScript (@aw/client/gates recommendedOption) and Kotlin (GateTexts.recommended) run the same cases.
